reviewer.description: Deep PR-level code review for security, architecture, and quality. The thorough gate — /check-architecture is the quick local check.
reviewer.prompt: Read .claude/subagents/reviewer.md for your detailed instructions, then review the code changes on this branch.

verifier.description: QA gate that verifies implementation matches GitHub issue acceptance criteria.
verifier.prompt: Read .claude/subagents/verifier.md for your detailed instructions, then verify the implementation on this branch.

investigator.description: Evidence gatherer for diagnosing problems. Collects facts systematically without drawing conclusions.
investigator.prompt: Read .claude/subagents/investigator.md for your detailed instructions, then gather evidence for the problem described.

analyzer.description: Codebase analyzer that finds patterns, related code, and integration points before implementing new features.
analyzer.prompt: Read .claude/subagents/analyzer.md for your detailed instructions, then analyze the codebase for the requested feature.

doc-checker.description: Detects stale documentation relative to code changes. Fast advisory check during PR creation.
doc-checker.prompt: Read .claude/subagents/doc-checker.md for your detailed instructions, then check documentation freshness for this branch.
